title: Stop breaking your own heart trying to make someone fit into your future when they belong in your past. 🛑
paragraphs: Stop breaking your own heart trying to make someone fit into your future when they belong in your past. 🛑

If their effort doesn’t match yours, it’s time to adjust your focus. A Gospel Warrior knows that your calling is too important to be delayed by people who are dragging their feet. Don't block your blessings by chasing something God is trying to remove.
Walk in your worth. Let them run.
📖 Bible Verse: “Don’t give what is holy to unholy people. Don’t give your pearls to pigs. They will just trample on them...” - Matthew 7:6 (CEV)
